operations.title: Entry 1243 — Every Compatible Five-Site Triple Inherits a Closed Pair
operations.body: All 242 compatible triple orbits inherit a closed pair: 172 have unit subpairs only, 56 have both unit and t=0 subpairs, and 14 have t=0 subpairs only. Thus 228 triple stationarity ideals are units and the remaining 14 are confined to total-energy support. No independent three-wall elimination remains.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the complete compatible triple Landau census by inheritance
operations.body: Entry 1243: every one of the 242 compatible triple orbits contains a closed pair. Counts: 172 unit-only, 56 unit+t0, 14 t0-only. Hence no genuine three-wall stationarity calculation survives. Next is the hereditary hypergraph test for active sets of size >=4 across all 180 source terms.
